info.title: Cloudexus API
info.summary: The catalog, stock, prices, invoices, partners and orders, and the warehouse app's bookings.
info.description: JSON in and out; every message in English. Amounts are in the primary currency (meta.currency); translatable text comes in the language asked for (meta.language). The whole description, for people, is web/API.md — and inside the application under API → API documentation.

post.description: Returns a user token (cxu_…), the only time it can be read. With two-step sign-in on, the password alone is 403 with details.two_factor_required; send the same body again with code. 10 failures from one IP in 15 minutes: 429.

username.description: The username or the email address.

code.description: The two-step code, or a recovery code.

401.description: Wrong username or password, or a wrong code.

403.description: Two-step sign-in is on: send code.

post.description: This device only; 403 with an integration token.

get.summary: The user behind a user token
get.description: For an app to check its stored token at start-up; 403 with an integration token.
A tree by parent_id, ordered by the translated name.

200.description: The OpenAPI document, with this installation's address.

post.description: The order number is made by the server, and so is the total.

get.summary: An order, with its lines and addresses

put.description: An invoiced order is read only: 409.

delete.description: Only a draft or cancelled order that was never invoiced; otherwise 409.

get.description: The master list product parameters take their name from.

put.summary: Update or create by tax number

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Without it only the product's own price and the rules for everyone apply.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: The document's date; today when not given.

get.description: q searches SKU, name and barcode.
Matched against the barcode first, the SKU second; active products only. A query parameter, as scanned codes can contain a slash.

200.description: The product, and where its stock is.

post.description: Needs a user token whose role has stock.move. All or nothing.
Needs a user token whose role has stock.move. All or nothing; checked against the warehouse's stock, one booking after the other.
Needs a user token whose role has stock.move. Each line is an out movement and an in movement. All or nothing.

get.description: For what is on a shelf, GET /stock?location_id=.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Exactly this code: a scanned shelf label.

token.description: An integration token (API → API users) or a user token from POST /auth/login (cxu_…).

apiKey.name: X-Api-Key
apiKey.description: The same token, for servers that strip the Authorization header.

q.name: q
q.description: Free-text search; the fields searched differ per list.

updated_since.name: updated_since
updated_since.description: Only records changed since then: for a delta sync.

language.name: language
language.description: The language translatable text comes in (see GET /languages); a missing translation falls back to the default. An unknown code is 422.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Makes a resend safe: the same key with the same request, from the same token's owner within 7 days, gets the first answer again (with Idempotent-Replayed: true) and is not done again. 409 while the first is still being worked on; 422 for the same key with another request.

Forbidden.description: The endpoint needs a user token, or the user's role lacks the permission.

Conflict.description: A conflict: an invoiced order, or the same request still being worked on under the same Idempotency-Key.

Unprocessable.description: The request does not make sense; details may say which lines.

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit exceeded: 60 requests a minute per token (per user for user tokens).

details.description: For a client to act on: which lines are short of stock, two_factor_required.

Currency.description: The primary currency every amount is in. Amounts are never converted.

default.description: The default language's code, which a missing translation falls back to.

role.description: The older split, kept for existing clients: admin means super admin.

sale_price.description: Net; when set, the active price.

path.description: A relative upload path or a full URL.

value.description: 1 primary unit is this many of this currency: amount * value.

code.description: Unique within the warehouse: what a shelf label says.

paid_amount.description: What has been received; the balance is total_amount - paid_amount.

price.description: The net unit price: the lowest of the list price, the sale price and the price rules that fit.

addresses.description: On PUT, given: replaces every address; left out: they stay. One without city, postal_code and street is not saved.

partner_id.description: Required on POST: an existing partner.

status.description: invoiced is set by issuing the invoice, and cannot be sent.

shipping_address_id.description: One of the partner's addresses; 0 or none: none.

items.description: Required on POST, at least one line. On PUT, given: replaces the lines; left out: they stay.

location_id.description: The default location of every line.

note.description: At most 200 characters; "Mobil app" when not given.
